questions.stem: An L-shaped room has overall dimensions 10 m by 7 m, with a 4 m by 3 m rectangle cut from one corner. What is the area of the L-shape?
questions.explanation: Full rectangle area = 10 x 7 = 70 m squared. Cut-out area = 4 x 3 = 12 m squared. L-shape area = 70 - 12 = 58 m squared.

questions.stem: A shape consists of a rectangle 8 cm by 5 cm with an isosceles triangle on top. The triangle has the same 8 cm base and a height of 3 cm. What is the total area?
questions.explanation: Rectangle area = 8 x 5 = 40 cm squared. Triangle area = (1/2) x 8 x 3 = 12 cm squared. Total = 40 + 12 = 52 cm squared.

questions.stem: A rectangular piece of card measures 20 cm by 15 cm. A triangle with base 8 cm and height 6 cm is cut from one corner. What is the remaining area?
questions.explanation: Rectangle area = 20 x 15 = 300 cm squared. Triangle area = (1/2) x 8 x 6 = 24 cm squared. Remaining = 300 - 24 = 276 cm squared.

questions.stem: A T-shaped cross-section has a horizontal rectangle 12 cm by 3 cm on top and a vertical rectangle 4 cm by 8 cm below. What is the total area?
questions.explanation: Top rectangle = 12 x 3 = 36 cm squared. Bottom rectangle = 4 x 8 = 32 cm squared. Total = 36 + 32 = 68 cm squared.

questions.stem: A rectangle 12 cm by 8 cm has a semicircle of diameter 8 cm removed from one of the shorter sides. What is the remaining area? (Use pi = 3.14)
questions.explanation: Rectangle area = 12 x 8 = 96 cm squared. Semicircle: radius = 4 cm, area = (1/2) x pi x 4^2 = (1/2) x 3.14 x 16 = 25.12 cm squared. Remaining = 96 - 25.12 = 70.88 cm squared.
